name: adaptorch_route_topology
description: Get authenticated topology and PESCO evidence advice from the hosted engine. No provider call, run creation or quota debit. This does not authorize execution.

prefer_ensemble_singleton.description: Price the same flag adaptorch_run accepts: route single-node DAGs to multi_model_ensemble and report what that replication costs before a run pays for it. true = explicit on, false = explicit off, null/omitted = auto policy.

model.description: Optional model id used for the USD cost estimate in orchestration_value. Unknown models report null.

measured_quality_gain.description: Accuracy gain the caller measured for the routed topology versus the baseline. Never inferred; without it replication topologies stay unproven.

min_quality_gain.description: Caller-owned acceptance bar the measured gain must reach to justify replication spend.
